intro: Relive the American Revolution through the paws of two historical heroes!
description:
Founding Paws follows Chompy the beaver and Sunny the eaglet through the American Revolution as they help dump tea into Boston Harbour, sound the alarm during Paul Revere's midnight ride, and travel to Philadelphia to witness the Continental Congress and inspire Thomas Jefferson's drafting of the Declaration. Decades later in the modern era, the lifelong friends sit together watching Fourth of July fireworks, proudly reflecting on the incredible nation they helped build.

Features:
• Fully dubbed in English. Characters with their own voices and personalities.
• 10 chapters. A complete story. Above 10,000 words.
• Full-colour, professional-quality images.
• Full background music and sound effects throughout.
• Read together or let a child explore alone.
• Short sessions. Easy to pause and pick up anytime.
• Themes: courage, friendship, self-acceptance.
• Ages 4–8.
• No ads - No in-app purchases - All ages.
